subject: Banking
title: Wells Fargo's Fake Accounts
description: One-minute skill: Wells Fargo's Fake Accounts.

hook.text: Wells Fargo employees opened 3.5 million fake accounts without customer consent.

buildup.text: Employees faced extreme pressure to cross-sell products. Each banker had to open 8 accounts per customer per day.

discovery.text: The scandal cost Wells Fargo $3 billion in fines and its CEO.

twist.text: Employees had warned management for years. Internal complaints were ignored because the fraud was profitable.

climax.text: Wells Fargo's scandal showed that toxic sales culture creates systemic fraud.

punchline.text: 3.5 million fake accounts. Years of warnings ignored. Profit beat ethics.

quiz.question: How many fake accounts did Wells Fargo employees create?
